validate_timeline_schedule: validate a dataflow graph schedule to ensure tensors are allocated and preserved correctly across timesteps
validate_address_allocation: validate memory address allocations to ensure tensors never overlap in memory at any timestep
validate_node_ordering: validate that nodes in a dataflow graph schedule execute in correct topological order relative to fanin dependencies
extract_node_ordering: extract the execution ordering of nodes from a dataflow graph schedule including nodes with no fanout
parse_schedule_item: parse a schedule item string to extract its integer timestep value for scheduling validation
